The '''2025–26 [[Thai League Cup]]''' marked the 16th season of [[Thailand]]'s knockout football competition in its second era. This edition of the League Cup signaled the tournament's return to Thai football after a 10-year hiatus. Sponsored by [[Muang Thai Life Assurance]] and Muang Thai Insurance, it was officially known as the '''Muang Thai Cup''' ({{langx|th|เมืองไทย คัพ}}).<ref>{{cite news |url=https://www.thairath.co.th/sport/thaifootball/2882291 |title=ส.บอลจับมือ เมืองไทยประกันชีวิต-เมืองไทยประกันภัย จัด เมืองไทย คัพ (in Thai). |work=thairath.co.th |date=11 September 2025}}</ref> 80 clubs were accepted into the competition, which commenced with the first qualification round on 7 October 2025 and concluded with the final on 24 May 2026. Notably, the tournament was open exclusively to clubs from [[Thai League 1]], [[Thai League 2]], and [[Thai League 3]].<ref>{{cite news |url=https://www.siamsport.co.th/football-thailand/thai-league-cup/89898/ |title=สโมสรไทยได้เตะแน่! สมาคมฟุตบอลเตรียมแถลงเปิดตัวผู้สนับสนุนลีกคัพ (in Thai). |work=siamsport.co.th |date=10 September 2025}}</ref>

The competition structure was as follows: Clubs from Thai League 3 began their journey in the qualifying rounds, which are organized regionally. As the tournament progresses, clubs from Thai League 2 enter during the play-off round. The first round then saw the entry of clubs from Thai League 1, who await the winners of the previous rounds.

The competition offered the champions a prize of 5 million [[Thai baht|baht]], while the runners-up earned 1 million baht. In addition to domestic silverware, the winner of the final earned qualification for the [[2026–27 ASEAN Club Championship]]. The tournament's reintroduction marked its return to the Thai football calendar as a regional competition involving clubs from across the country.<ref>{{cite news |url=https://www.siamsport.co.th/football-thailand/thai-league-cup/89953/ |title=ลีกคัพ ชื่อใหม่! เปิดตัว เมืองไทย CUP ศึกน็อกเอาต์ ชิง 5 ล้าน พร้อมสิทธิ์ลุยอาเซียน (in Thai). |work=siamsport.co.th |date=11 September 2025}}</ref>

==Results==
<small>'''''Note:''' T1: Clubs from [[Thai League 1]]; T2: Clubs from [[Thai League 2]]; T3: Clubs from [[Thai League 3]].''</small>

===First qualification round===
26 clubs from the [[2025–26 Thai League 3]] participated in the first qualification round of the 2025–26 Thai League Cup. The draw for this round took place on 20 August 2025.<ref>{{cite news |url=https://www.siamsport.co.th/football-thailand/thai-league-cup/90905/ |title=สมาคมฟุตบอลจับสลาก เมืองไทย คัพ 2025/26 รอบคัดเลือก 51 ทีมชิงตั๋ว (in Thai). |work=siamsport.co.th |date=25 September 2025}}</ref> 39 goals were scored in this round.

===First round===
The first round consists of 32 clubs. This includes 16 clubs advancing from the qualification play-off round, with 8 clubs representing the [[2025–26 Thai League 2]] and 8 clubs from the [[2025–26 Thai League 3]]. Additionally, 16 top-tier clubs from the [[2025–26 Thai League 1]] joined the competition at this stage. The draw for this round took place on 28 November 2025.<ref>{{cite news |url=https://www.siamsport.co.th/football-thailand/thai-league-cup/95107/ |title=จับติ้วเมืองไทย คัพ รอบ 32 ทีม: บุรีรัมย์ฯ ชน ธนบุรี ยูไนเต็ด–เมืองทอง บุกเยือนบางกอก 27–28 ธ.ค. 2568 (in Thai). |work=siamsport.co.th |date=28 November 2025}}</ref> 46 goals were scored in this round.
